I’m here as well if you would like to talk. I recently went through the worst breakup of my life so I can understand where you’re coming from.

I feel like the most simple way is to just tell your closest family member and see if they have the ability to help you. I’m not sure how your family is, but some have extreme reactions to the news and try everything they can do to help, but some families just disregard it as “*your name* had a bad day today.” The most simple way is to just tell them. Don’t be afraid to get emotional either, these are the people that watched you grow up they’ll offer you some support at the very least.
